greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan -- a rare open stretch mid-charter, with the girls in Florida. What is pulling on you is next week's travel logistics, not today.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat departure still open
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 marina transfer, bag hold, and the pre-dawn Sept 20 checkout all need arranging from shore before the charter ends Saturday -- connectivity is thin once underway.

needsAttention.title: St Pete gap and rental car
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sept 20 with no lodging for the 20th-21st and the Sept 20 - Oct 5 full-size SUV still unbooked; both are flagged p1 and overdue in Todoist.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is a p1 now a day past due -- holiday inventory there sells out early, so a refundable hold now costs nothing.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England programming call
needsAttention.detail: The programming committee meets tomorrow at 1 PM ET on Zoom; worth a look at the agenda beforehand since you are on the committee.

flagged.title: Credit report changes
flagged.detail: myFICO flagged multiple changes to your TransUnion report and an updated score -- worth a login to confirm nothing looks off.

inbox.noise: About 40 newsletters and promos -- Resy, Chairish, Monocle, Delta, plus sailing and cooking lists.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Borlotti beans with sautéed baby kale
recipe.why: Early-autumn cooking leans on fresh shell beans and tender greens still coming in from the garden.

tasks.title: Check for a better St Pete Airbnb before the Sept 18 charge

acts.line: The calendar is empty -- a rare open stretch while the charter works its way along the Adriatic.
No meetings hold the afternoon; it is yours between ports.
A quiet close before the week's logistics gather toward Saturday's disembark.
